  [General]  Commands  Custom commands
  Shortcuts
  /               for commands                                      !               for shell commands                                ctrl + j        for newline
  enter           to submit message                                 @               for file paths                                    ctrl + v        to paste images
  ?               to show or close shortcuts                        esc             to cancel or close                                ctrl + p/n      browse history
  ctrl + c        clear/interrupt/exit                              tab             to queue while running                            alt(option) + v to start voice input
  ctrl + o        to expand tool output                             ctrl + g        to edit in $EDITOR                                ctrl + b        to send to background
  Browse or customize shortcuts with /keymap.
  Send feedback with /feedback.
  For CLI options: muse --help
  Esc to close
